# The Business Work

> Practical AI Agents & Chatbots, WhatsApp & Social Automation, CRM & Workflow Automation, and Restaurant & Cafe Table Ordering systems for small and medium businesses in India.

## Founder & Company Profile
- **Brand:** The Business Work
- **Founder:** Aman Rajbhar (Founder & Systems Architect)
- **What Aman Rajbhar Built:** Founded The Business Work in India to build custom, zero-package business automation systems—covering 4 core verticals (AI Agents & Chatbots, WhatsApp & Social Automation, CRM & Workflow Automation, and Restaurant & Cafe Table Ordering) plus an interactive Café & Restaurant OS live demo.
- **Headquarters & Service Region:** Boisar, Maharashtra, India (serving SMBs across India and globally)
- **Languages:** English, Hindi
- **Website:** https://www.thebusinesswork.com
- **Instagram:** https://instagram.com/thebusinesswork.co
- **Email:** hello@thebusinesswork.com | aman@thebusinesswork.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 79720 20292

## The 4 Core Services
1. **AI Agents & Chatbots:** https://www.thebusinesswork.com/services/ai-agents-chatbots
   - AI Sales Agents, AI Customer Support Agents, Website AI Chatbots, AI Lead Qualification Agents.
2. **WhatsApp & Social Automation:** https://www.thebusinesswork.com/services/whatsapp-social-automation
   - Official WhatsApp Cloud API workflows, automated replies, Instagram/social DM lead capture, appointment reminders, and order updates.
3. **CRM & Workflow Automation:** https://www.thebusinesswork.com/services/crm-workflow-automation
   - Automated lead pipelines, Google Sheets & CRM sync, follow-up reminders, invoicing/billing workflows, and custom business integrations.
4. **Restaurant & Cafe Table Ordering:** https://www.thebusinesswork.com/services/restaurant-cafe-table-ordering
   - QR code table ordering, live kitchen display system (KDS), menu management, and restaurant/cafe billing automation.
